brief: Golden noodle shapes drift in thick orange sauce across the screen, occasionally splashing upward as if boiling. A single piece of cheddar rests statically until a mouse click shatters it into scattered crumbs that float down slowly. Clicking again reforms the original bowl shape with greater density while the background hue cycles through warm yellow tones.

statement: This sketch creates an animated scene of golden noodles drifting in thick orange sauce, with subtle color shifts and motion suggesting a simmering bowl. A piece of cheddar cheese sits statically in the center until clicked, then explodes into floating crumbs. Each click reforms the cheese while intensifying the noodle animation through both visual density and background hue cycling through warm yellows. The movement comes from procedurally animated noodle shapes that drift organically across the canvas, with sauce colors that shift harmoniously over time.
